first-flight.name: First Flight
first-flight.hint: Pull back and release. Drag to the perch to cancel.

powder-row.name: Powder Row
powder-row.hint: Break the glass face to drop the roof.

glass-house.name: Glass House
glass-house.hint: The glass piers are weak. One hit drops the span.

stone-keep.name: Triple Tap
stone-keep.hint: Split hits three places at once. Tap in mid-air.

hilltop.name: Hilltop
hilltop.hint: The fort sits up on the plateau.

lone-guard.name: Lone Guard
lone-guard.hint: Aim for the glass band under the stone cap.

twin-posts.name: Dash Lane
twin-posts.hint: Tap during flight to dash through the beam.

glass-alley.name: Glass Alley
glass-alley.hint: Everything here is glass and stone.

tnt-porch.name: TNT Porch
tnt-porch.hint: Hit the red crate. The blast does the rest.

split-lesson.name: Grand Stand
split-lesson.hint: Chapter finale: bring the whole stand down.

heavy-gate.name: Heavy Gate
heavy-gate.hint: Heavy smashes stone. Tap to drop like a rock.

powder-stack.name: Powder Stack
powder-stack.hint: The keg under the face clears the base.

blast-shed.name: Blast Shed
blast-shed.hint: Blast detonates where you tap. Drop it in the shed.

mixed-yard.name: Mixed Yard
mixed-yard.hint: Chapter finale: crack the stone shell.

fuse-line.name: Fuse Line
fuse-line.hint: Three kegs, one fuse. Start the chain.

last-stand.name: Last Stand
last-stand.hint: The final fortress. Everything must fall.
